name: Netoribyou ~Suki de Hametai Wakejanai no ni...~
original_name: 寝取り病～好きでハメたいわけじゃないのに…～
source:
Ayafuji Sayaka gets kidnapped and turned into a special kind of zombie: one that cannot survive without having sex at least once a week. What's worse is that she needs to be stealing someone else's partner for it to count.

[Adapted from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/dlaf/=/link/work/aid/vndb/id/VJ015181.html]DLSite[/url]]
translation:
绫藤沙耶香被绑架并变成了一种特殊的僵尸：每周至少发生一次性行为就无法生存。更糟糕的是，她需要偷走别人的伴侣才算算。

[改编自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/dlaf/=/link/work/aid/vndb/id/VJ015181.html]DLSite[/url]]
